name: GlideElementDescriptor
title: GlideElementDescriptor - Scoped, Global
summary: The GlideElementDescriptor API provides information about individual fields in a glide record.
overview: There is no constructor for this class. Use the GlideElement or GlideRecord getED() method to obtain a GlideElementDescriptor object.

members.name: getAttachmentEncryptionType
members.summary: Returns the encryption type used for attachments on the element's table.
members.html:
This method is for use with the Edge Encryption plugin.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The encryption type used on attachments. Returns null if attachments on the element's table are not being encrypted. 
var grInc = new GlideRecord('incident');
grInc.query('priority', '1');

var field = grInc.getElement('priority');
var ed = field.getED();

var isEdge = ed.getAttachmentEncryptionType();
gs.info(isEdge);

Output:

null

members.name: isEncrypted
members.summary: Returns whether the field represented by this descriptor is configured for Column Level Encryption (CLE).
members.html:
Use this method to programmatically detect encrypted fields before reading or writing sensitive data, or to enforce access policies based on a field's encryption status. The Encryption Support plugin (com.glide.cle) must be active, otherwise isEncrypted() returns false regardless of field configuration.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean

Flag that indicates whether the field is configured for CLE.

Valid values:
  • true: Field is configured for CLE.
  • false: Field isn't encrypted, or the Encryption Support (com.glide.cle) plugin isn't active.
The following server-side script uses isEncrypted() to check whether the short_description field on the Incident table is encrypted before logging its value. Copy this into a Background Script or Business Rule on your instance to test.
Note:
Use the GlideRecord - getED() or Scoped GlideElement - getED() method to obtain a GlideElementDescriptor object.
// Retrieve a sample Incident record
var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
gr.setLimit(1);
gr.query();

if (gr.next()) {
    // Get the GlideElement for the field you want to inspect
    var element = gr.getElement('short_description');

    // Retrieve the descriptor from the element
    var descriptor = element.getED();

    // Check whether the field is configured for Column Level Encryption
    if (descriptor.isEncrypted()) {
        gs.info('short_description is encrypted. Value: ' + element.getDisplayValue());
    } else {
        gs.info('short_description is NOT encrypted. Value: ' + gr.getValue('short_description'));
    }
}
Output (unencrypted):
short_description is NOT encrypted. Value: Unable to connect to network
Output (CLE enabled on the field):
short_description is encrypted. Value: Unable to connect to network

members.name: isMandatory
members.summary: Determines whether the element is mandatory and must contain a value before the record can be saved.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean Flag that indicates whether the associated element is mandatory and must contain a value before the record containing the element can be saved.

Possible values:

  • true: element must contain a value; mandatory field
  • false: element does not have to contain a value

This example shows how to check whether the name field is mandatory.

var isRecordValid;
var now_GR = new GlideRecord('my_table');
var field = now_GR.getElement('name');
var elementDescriptor = field.getED();
now_GR.query();
while (now_GR.next()) {
if (elementDescriptor.isMandatory() && !now_GR.name) {
       isRecordValid = false;
  }
}

members.name: isVirtual
members.summary: Returns true if the element is a virtual element.
members.html:
A virtual element is a calculated field as set by the dictionary definition of the field. Virtual fields cannot be encrypted.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean Returns true if the element is a virtual element. 
var grInc = new GlideRecord('incident');
grInc.query('priority', '1');

var field = grInc.getElement('priority');
var ed = field.getED();

var isVirtual = ed.isVirtual();
gs.info(isVirtual);

Output:

false
